limits: CPU-only independent audit of existing parent-owned actual hardware receipts; no GPU/model/SSH/network/signal/global-setting execution by reviewer. Pure collector run used explicit no-model/no-network/no-subprocess/no-signal guards.
Hash binding authenticates referenced local bytes under the parent trust model, not cryptographic execution attestation or independently observed hardware execution.

Comparison is warmed, fresh-cache hidden-only MTP serial prefill versus compound pipeline prefill, with unchanged MTP/rollback/Q4 affine BF16 components, 28/36 placement and group32. It is not native autoregressive latency or the older discarded-logit comparator.

Loading/head load and numerical admission are excluded from request timings. Numerical admission warms extra shapes; this is not cold-start performance. EOS and MTP finish ACK included; local-rank wall has separate final synchronization.

Only two measured repeat pairs per case. The six long-case thresholds are descriptive median paired-ratio observations, not confidence intervals, p95, pooled overrides, statistical-confidence guarantees or universal latency floors.
All 18 cases are retained. Six short cases regress in whole-request elapsed; five short cases regress in TTFT. Do not claim all18 faster.
structured-1536 contains 1535 actual formatted prompt tokens; preserved literally, not repaired. Shorter EOS-ended outputs are retained, not padded.

Small and full target checks run in the same actual rank process before each phase requests. MTP head execution is on rank0; head metrics received by rank1 are not a second independent head execution.

Causal evaluated-receive-credit/chunk/drain event grammar and source establish bounded protocol work, not synchronized GPU-kernel occupancy, concurrent kernel proof or network-only performance attribution.

Exactly 95 warning-level2 samples are retained under the explicit allowed1/2 noncritical amendment. No admitted4, invalid/missing level, >1second coverage gap or deadline overrun. Sampled guards cannot guarantee immunity from unsampled OS/GPU-driver stalls/crashes; this is not strict-normal-pressure qualification.
Per-request recorded MLX allocator peaks are not RSS/system residency, full loading/gate peak, a minimum memory floor or isolated before/after memory savings.
Two explicit Python payload-reference releases are source-bound and common to both modes. They do not prove multi-GB memory savings or isolate a physical memory delta.
Server lookup-preservation conclusions use byte-identical source and completed receipts, not new remote source-weight filesystem readback or a new live wire capture.
Parent post-suite-health.json records fresh parent live checks; this audit only reads and binds that artifact and original phase endpoint/cleanup records, without reviewer network/SSH/PID probes.
Both historical strict-normal pilot failures remain failed and unchanged. No historical failure is relabeled by the amended criterion.
No arbitrary-prompt equivalence, coding/reasoning accuracy, visual inference, autonomy/tool use, persistent deployment or24–48h soak qualification. No commit, push or task-list closure performed.
verdict: PASS: exact full84 physical receipt collection and all six individual long-case descriptive latency targets under the explicit noncritical1/2 amendment. Not cryptographic execution attestation, strict-normal pressure qualification or statistical confidence.
